title: Publish test-skills as a public opum-ai repo with CI
description: User request 2026-09-26: publish to opum-ai as a public repo. Do NOT add it to the opum marketplace yet (user wants to test first). Includes repo CI (fast tier plus the constitution gate on PRs, slow tier nightly), dev/main setup, and scrubbing local-only files.

acceptanceCriteria.text: opum-ai/test-skills exists, public, with dev and main
CI runs the fast tier and the constitution gate on the PR and is green on the PR run

finalSummary: Published opum-ai/test-skills (public; main default; dev created from GitHub's initial commit via the API because a new repo has no origin/dev; squash-only; delete-branch-on-merge). Development history squashed into PR #1 so local-only files never reach the public history. Repo CI: PR tier on Python 3.9 and 3.12 plus this repo's own constitution gate; slow tier nightly. The PR's own gate caught real problems (eval fixtures judged, private-helper coupling, conditional assertions, a test skipped on 3.9); all were fixed in the PR. Evidence: PR #1, CI run 36256545549 green on 3.9 and 3.12. Not in opum-marketplace (its plugins: opum-lore, opum-output-styles, opum-quest, proof-skills), per the user's instruction to test first.
